record.summary: Guideline under Article 13 of the AI Act to encourage voluntary and proactive efforts by all actors toward trustworthy AI, in keeping with international norms. Its policies are a risk-based approach, active stakeholder involvement, life-cycle AI governance and agile response. R&D institutions and utilization business operators are to build AI governance across the life cycle, ensure transparency, counter risks of misuse for crime, curb hallucinations and disinformation including deepfakes, and work to develop technology to identify AI-generated content. The State is to fulfil accountability when using AI and appoint AI governance officers in ministries; citizens are to use AI responsibly.
record.notes: A draft (ＡＩ指針（案）) was open for public comment from 5 to 11 Dec 2025; the guideline was adopted by decision of the AI Strategic Headquarters on 19 Dec 2025. The Cabinet Office page on the guideline also lists the ministries' guidelines on AI, among them the AI Guidelines for Business (revised March 2026), and related international norms such as the Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles and ISO/IEC 42001.

verification.note: Stored on 11 Oct 2026: the Cabinet Office guideline page, the one-page Japanese overview, the English overview and the Cabinet Office's full provisional English translation (dated 19 Dec 2025, every page headed 'Provisional translation', with the remark to refer to the original text for accuracy). Stored on 14 Oct 2026: the full Japanese text of the guideline (10 pages, 令和７年12月19日 人工知能戦略本部決定). Together they confirm the title, the decision of the AI Strategic Headquarters of 19 Dec 2025 and the content; the summary is written from the full Japanese text, with terms as the government's translation renders them (一気通貫 as 'life-cycle', 活用事業者 as 'utilization business operators'). The page title and first heading misspell the guideline as 適性性確保; the second heading, the overview and the guideline itself read 適正性確保. The English translation's file name carries 20260116 and the English overview's 20260220.

judgment.status_reasoning: The guideline was adopted by decision of the AI Strategic Headquarters on 19 Dec 2025 (令和7年12月19日 本部決定) and is still listed as the current guideline on the Cabinet Office page stored on 11 Oct 2026; it encourages voluntary efforts and imposes no obligations, so 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands on 14 Oct 2026.

changes.summary: Written from the full Japanese text now stored: Art. 13 basis and voluntary efforts (1(1)); four basic policies (1(3)); duties of R&D institutions and utilization business operators (2(1)-(4): life-cycle AI governance, transparency, sufficient safety including misuse for crime, hallucinations, disinformation and deepfakes, technology to identify AI outputs; business continuity plans (2(4)) left out for length); the State's accountability and AI governance officers (3(4)); citizens (4). 活用事業者 rendered as the government translation does ('utilization business operators', not 'developers and businesses').
changes.notes: The deciding body is named on the provisional translation's cover ('Decision of the Artificial Intelligence Strategic Headquarters'), so the hedge 'understood from context' is removed; remarks on when the English files were posted moved to verification.note.

leads: The Cabinet Office page lists 17 ministry guidelines on AI; among those with safety content are MIC's 'Guideline on technical measures to ensure AI security' (ＡＩのセキュリティ確保のための技術的対策に係るガイドライン, R8.3), the Digital Agency's guideline on procurement and use of generative AI in government (R7.5) and the plant-safety AI reliability evaluation guideline (R3.3).
The page gives the AI Guidelines for Business a revision date of R8.3 (March 2026), which bears on JP-02.
